name: Back-to-School Night Presentation
description:
Create a 3-page Back-to-School Night presentation flipchart for a high school English class.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart in ActivInspire.
2. **Page 1 (Welcome)**: Add title 'Welcome to English 10', teacher name 'Ms. Rivera', and room 'Room 214'. Add a decorative shape (like a rectangle border).
3. **Page 2 (Grading Policy)**: Add title 'Grading'. Create 5 boxes (using shapes) for these categories: Essays (30%), Participation (15%), Quizzes (15%), Projects (25%), Homework (15%). Text must be visible.
4. **Page 3 (Contact & Dates)**: Add title 'Stay Connected'. Add email 'rivera@lincolnhs.edu'. List these dates: September 15 (Progress Reports), October 20 (Parent Conferences), December 18 (Final Exams).
5. Save as '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/back_to_school_night.flipchart'.

Ensure you create exactly 3 pages and use the Text and Shape tools.
